text.tspan: lid and interlock, bowl and spout, rotor (basket, vanes, mesh, sleeve, seals), drive and controller, and four use steps: pour, spin, change the sleeve, read the sleeve.
Ratings use the model's numbers where it has them (capture, flow, sleeve life, stress); the rest is our judgement for the team to challenge in the session.
